description: A ref:// link in a message opens the code it points at, snapshotted when the message was sent.
agent_instructions:
Switchboard renders ref:// links as a code viewer, snapshotting the file at send time.
Scanned only in `full` on channel_reply and notify_human. Not in summary, title, fullSpoken, a crosstalk_send body, or a code fence.
Label as `filename : symbol`, not prose. The console draws that as a chip with a code icon.
Paths read like a shell: bare is project-relative, / is the filesystem root, ~/ is home.
Waypoints match any descendant, so unnamed layers between do not matter. Qualify fully: a partial chain can resolve narrower.
A destination ends at the first space or unbalanced ), silently truncating the ref. Wrap it in angle brackets, or percent-encode: %20 space, %29 close paren, %2E%2E literal .., %40 literal @.
The file tier fails the send loudly (missing, not text, a secret, too large without narrowing), as does a malformed ref, with its offset. Resolution never fails: a stale chain still sends and opens on a text match or the whole file, so no error does NOT mean it landed where you meant.

Examples:
[cart.ts : add](ref://src/cart.ts:Cart:add) method in a class
[App.tsx : handleSubmit](ref://src/App.tsx:App:handleSubmit) reaches through unnamed layers
[Svc.cs : Compute](ref://src/Svc.cs:Acme.Services:Service:Compute) dotted namespace, or :Acme:Services
[engine.cpp : step](ref://src/engine.cpp:Physics::World::step) or Physics:World:step
[cart.ts : qty](ref://src/cart.ts:Cart:add:arguments:qty) one parameter, :arguments for the whole list
[nginx.conf : server](ref:///etc/nginx/nginx.conf#server) absolute path
[bashrc : PATH](ref://~/.bashrc#export%20PATH) home path, encoded space
[cart.ts : push](<ref://src/cart.ts:Cart:add#items.push(item);>) bracket-wrapped matcher
[cart.ts : body](ref://src/cart.ts:Cart:add#this.items..reset()) range from..to
[cart.ts : second](ref://src/cart.ts:Cart:add#count@after:reset()) occurrence after an anchor
